text:
lina: Hey team, Customer J. Doe reporting streaming chat responses that cut off mid-JSON then client reconnects and sees duplicate billing events. They say it happens behind Cloudflare + ALB. Repro attached.
customer-jdoe: repro: connect to /v1/stream with Authorization header, wait ~30-45s, last chunk silent, client reconnects and receives partial JSON then full new response. Billing shows two charges.
ben: do we have traces/ingress logs? sample request id? :thinking_face:
customer-jdoe: request_id=rr-2026-03-15-81, I attached pcap and nginx access logs. Also seeing 502 from ALB once in tcpdump before reconnect.
srini: quick guess: Cloudflare HTTP/2 connection coalescing + ALB idle probe causing a half-close that our runtime treats as completed chunk. Client sees no final delimiter and reconnects. Could lead to double-count if we record tokens on flush vs final close.
marta: important: is token billing triggered on chunk flush or on connection close in our pipeline? I thought we charge when send_token finishes.
ben: we charge as tokens stream out; but the client reconnecting and resuming a new request causes another set of tokens. The double-charge likely because initial attempt sent tokens but didn't include the final event that marks completion, so the app retried and consumed more tokens.
ops-bot: NOTE: ALB default idle timeout 60s. If Cloudflare holds upstream longer and ALB probes, half-close may happen. Envoy/nginx can also coalesce trailing small writes.
lina: From pcap: after ~37s of silence there is an RST from ALB toward origin, then client reconnect 1s later. Logs show upstream wrote last chunk but it was buffered at the proxy for 18ms then coalesced with a keepalive and dropped when probe hit.
ben: repro steps I can run: curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
ben: if I simulate Cloudflare by proxying via h2 and delayed small final chunk, I can reproduce the silent trailing gap.
srini: mitigation options:
- increase ALB idle timeout > 120s for affected services
- disable proxy buffering where possible (nginx: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on;`)
- add periodic small heartbeat SSE comment `: hb\n\n` every 15s so proxies don't consider stream idle
- server-side: only mark request complete after final sentinel event, avoid emitting billing/usage until that sentinel is persisted
marta: can we add idempotency marker for streaming so client reconnect can resume without new billing? That's medium effort.
lina: customer asked for temporary workaround. Recommend heartbeat + raising ALB idle timeout + Cloudflare "origin keepalive" config change. Provide exact curl repro and a minimal nginx config change.
ben: nginx snippet we tested:
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_pass http://origin;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_set_header Host $host;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
}
```
ben: and client curl command to reproduce:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -N https://edge.example.com/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
```
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T18:42:10 UTC: candidate runtime change to delay billing write until final sentinel persisted -> can be canaried on staging.
srini: action items:
- SRE: try heartbeat and nginx change on staging (ben)
- Product: advise customer on config + request quota refund for duplicated billing (marta)
- Runtime: add guard to not finalize charge until sentinel persisted or 10s idle after last token (queue PR) (deploy-bot assigned)
lina: customer accepted temp workaround, asked for ETA on fix and refund. I'll escalate billing and send follow-up. Thanks all :pray:
marta: I'm on billing, will patch invoice and follow up by EOD.
ben: last note: if you see partial JSON on client side, suggest client side to treat stream as idempotent until final `event: done` or similar marker, and avoid auto-retry within 3s.
customer-jdoe: thanks team! repro logs and pcap in the ticket. Appreciate quick triage.
